title: Reproduction package: Processing errors, population definitions and analytic choices in EUROCONTROL state-level aviation CO2 statistics
description: Reproduction package for: Yurtsever, Ö. Processing errors, population definitions and analytic choices in public aviation CO2 statistics: a layered robustness audit of EUROCONTROL state-level data (manuscript under review). The package contains the exact input vintage (17 EUROCONTROL state-level CO2 files downloaded on 4 July 2026, with SHA-256 hashes), the analysis code that reproduces every number, table and figure (processing-error audit and stress tests, a 256-specification multiverse on corrected data, influence diagnostics, annual panel regressions, a pre-pandemic comparison, emissions per departure and volatility analyses), an identifier crosswalk, automated tests and a pinned software environment. Version 2.0 replaces version 1, whose description and contents referred to an earlier draft.
